claude.result:
Done! I fixed the floating-point precision issue. The problem was in `src/money.js` — when converting prices like 39.95 to cents, the calculation `39.95 * 100` produces `3995.0000000000005` instead of exactly `3995` due to how floating-point numbers work.

I added `Math.round()` to both `parseEuros()` and `cellCents()` to round the result to the nearest integer. This ensures prices are always stored as whole cents.

Verification:
- All 50 existing tests pass
- Successfully added Gym for 39.95 (stored as 3995 cents)
- Netflix (12.99) and Spotify (10.99) continue to work
